pages.title: Folded Protein Crystal
pages.text: A long chain of amino acids that has found its one native shape out of more possible shapes than there are atoms in the universe - and frozen in that shape as a crystal. Levinthal's paradox says it should take forever. It took milliseconds.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Proteins fold quickly because the energy landscape funnels them. I mapped that funnel with a molecular orbital lattice, let a quantum processor search it, and grew the folded chain from recombinant DNA in nutrient broth.

Made in $(item)Folding Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Ribosome Workshop chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Protein Folding.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cryptochrome Magnetoreceptor, Morphogenic Serum, Prion Lattice, Quantum Chlorophyll.
